outcomes.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDonHang FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaHoaDon) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 500
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(SoTien), 0) AS DoanhThuHomQua FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' DAY) LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDonMangVe FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND LoaiDon = 'Mang về' LIMIT 500
SELECT AVG(TongTien) AS TrungBinhMoiHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SoDonDangMo FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND TrangThaiOrder = 'Đang mở' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaBan) AS SoBanDuocPhucVu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND TrangThaiOrder <> 'Đã hủy' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDonHuy FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND TrangThaiOrder = 'Đã hủy' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaNguyenLieu) AS SoNguyenLieu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' LIMIT 500

SELECT TenMon, SUM(SoLuongMon) AS TongSoLuong FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND YEARWEEK(BusinessDate, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE, 1) GROUP BY TenMon ORDER BY TongSoLuong DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT TenMon, SUM(ThanhTienMon) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') GROUP BY TenMon ORDER BY DoanhThu ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DonGiaNhap FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'PHIEU_NHAP' AND TenNguyenLieu = 'Thịt bò' ORDER BY BusinessDate DESC, MaPhieuNhap DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoLuongOrder FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND LoaiDon = 'Tại chỗ' LIMIT 500
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(DonGiaNhap * SoLuongNhap), 0) AS TongTienNhapHomNay FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'PHIEU_NHAP' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaNguyenLieu) AS SoNguyenLieuDuoiMucTonToiThieu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND SoLuongTon < MucTonToiThieu LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoLuongOrderChuaThanhToan FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND TrangThaiOrder = 'Đang mở' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaHoaDon) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEARWEEK(BusinessDate, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE, 1) LIMIT 500

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoLuongOrderMangVe FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND LoaiDon = 'Mang về' AND BusinessDate BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '6' DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500
SELECT SUM(SoTien) AS TongTienThuHomNay FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SoLuongGiaoDichKho FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(SoTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT o.MaBan, SUM(h.TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly AS h JOIN vw_ai_quanly AS o ON o.LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND o.MaOrder = h.MaOrder WHERE h.LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND DATE_FORMAT(h.BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') GROUP BY o.MaBan ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT PhuongThuc, SUM(SoTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY PhuongThuc LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%m') AS Thang, COUNT(DISTINCT MaHoaDon) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, SUM(SoTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT LoaiDon, COUNT(*) AS SoDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '29' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE AND LoaiDon IN ('Tại chỗ', 'Mang về') GROUP BY LoaiDon LIMIT 500
SELECT PhuongThuc, SUM(SoTien) AS TongTienThanhToan FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '7' DAY) GROUP BY PhuongThuc LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY SUM(TongTien) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT HOUR(ThoiDiemXuat) AS Gio, COUNT(DISTINCT MaHoaDon) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' DAY) GROUP BY HOUR(ThoiDiemXuat) ORDER BY Gio LIMIT 500

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(SoTien), 0) / 30 AS DoanhThuTrungBinhMoiNgay FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '29' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, COUNT(*) AS SoGiaoDichThanhToan FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURRENT_DATE)) DAY) AND BusinessDate < DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURRENT_DATE)) DAY), INTERVAL '7' DAY) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500
SELECT TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' ORDER BY SoLuongTon DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT BusinessDate, COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDonHuy FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND TrangThaiOrder = 'Đã hủy' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m') GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT o.MaBan, SUM(t.SoTien) AS DoanhThu FROM (SELECT MaOrder, MaBan FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND TrangThaiOrder <> 'Đã hủy') AS o JOIN (SELECT MaOrder, MaHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON') AS h ON h.MaOrder = o.MaOrder JOIN (SELECT MaHoaDon, SoTien, BusinessDate FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN') AS t ON t.MaHoaDon = h.MaHoaDon WHERE t.BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '6' DAY) AND t.BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY o.MaBan ORDER BY o.MaBan LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, COUNT(DISTINCT MaHoaDon) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '5' MONTH) AND BusinessDate < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.ThanhTienMon), 0) AS TongGiaTriOrderHuy FROM vw_ai_quanly AS o JOIN vw_ai_quanly AS d ON d.LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND d.MaOrder = o.MaOrder WHERE o.LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND o.TrangThaiOrder = 'Đã hủy' AND DATE_FORMAT(o.BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') LIMIT 500

SELECT LyDoHuyOrder, COUNT(*) AS SoLan FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) AND NOT LyDoHuyOrder IS NULL AND LyDoHuyOrder <> '' GROUP BY LyDoHuyOrder ORDER BY SoLan DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT TenNhom, SUM(ThanhTienMon) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') GROUP BY TenNhom ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT GiaBinhQuanThang FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIA_VON_THANG' AND TenNguyenLieu = 'Gạo tẻ' AND Thang = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m') AS UNSIGNED) LIMIT 1

SELECT TenNhaCungCap, SUM(DonGiaNhap * SoLuongNhap) AS TongGiaTriNhap FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'PHIEU_NHAP' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY TenNhaCungCap ORDER BY TongGiaTriNhap DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') AS ThangNay, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m') AS ThangTruoc, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') THEN SoTien ELSE 0 END) AS DoanhThuThangNay, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m') THEN SoTien ELSE 0 END) AS DoanhThuThangTruoc, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') THEN SoTien ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m') THEN SoTien ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Tang' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') THEN SoTien ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m') THEN SoTien ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Giam' ELSE 'Khong doi' END AS XuHuong, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') THEN SoTien ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m') THEN SoTien ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '1' MONTH), '%Y%m') THEN SoTien ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2) AS PhanTramThayDoi FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, AVG(TongTien) AS DoanhThuTrungBinhMoiDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT d.BusinessDate FROM (SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThuNgay FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate) AS d WHERE d.DoanhThuNgay > (SELECT AVG(x.DoanhThuNgay) FROM (SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThuNgay FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate) AS x) ORDER BY d.BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ThoiDiemXuat, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS GioDoanhThu, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '6' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ThoiDiemXuat, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY GioDoanhThu LIMIT 500

SELECT LoaiDon, DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '3' MONTH) GROUP BY LoaiDon, DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang, LoaiDon LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThuNgay, SUM(SUM(TongTien)) OVER (ORDER BY BusinessDate) AS DoanhThuLuyKe FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL (DAYOFMONTH(CURRENT_DATE) - 1) DAY) AND BusinessDate < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(CURRENT_DATE), INTERVAL '1' DAY) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND SoLuongTon > (SELECT AVG(SoLuongTon) FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO') LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, ROUND(AVG(SoDon), 2) AS SoDonTrungBinhMoiNgay FROM (SELECT BusinessDate, COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDon FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate) AS t GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT PhuongThuc, SUM(SoTien) AS TongSoTien, ROUND(SUM(SoTien) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(SoTien) FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE), 2) AS TiLePhanTram FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY PhuongThuc ORDER BY TongSoTien DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND((COALESCE(rev.doanhthu, 0) - COALESCE(cogs.giovon, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(rev.doanhthu, 0), 0) * 100, 2) AS BienLoiNhuanGopUocTinh FROM (SELECT SUM(TongTien) AS doanhthu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') AND BusinessDate < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01')) AS rev CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(ABS(gdk.SoLuong) * gvt.GiaBinhQuanThang) AS giovon FROM vw_ai_quanly AS gdk JOIN vw_ai_quanly AS gvt ON gvt.LoaiBanGhi = 'GIA_VON_THANG' AND gvt.MaNguyenLieu = gdk.MaNguyenLieu AND gvt.Thang = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' MONTH) * 100 + MONTH(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' MONTH) WHERE gdk.LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND gdk.LoaiGiaoDich = 'Trừ tự động' AND gdk.BusinessDate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' MONTH, '%Y-%m-01') AND gdk.BusinessDate < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01')) AS cogs LIMIT 500

SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SUM(CASE WHEN LoaiBanGhi = 'PHIEU_NHAP' THEN SoLuongNhap ELSE 0 END) AS SoLuongNhap, SUM(CASE WHEN LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' THEN SoLuong ELSE 0 END) AS SoLuongTieuHao FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE AND (LoaiBanGhi = 'PHIEU_NHAP' OR (LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' AND LoaiGiaoDich IN ('Trừ tự động', 'Xuất thủ công'))) AND NOT MaNguyenLieu IS NULL GROUP BY MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh ORDER BY MaNguyenLieu LIMIT 500

SELECT TenMon, SUM(ThanhTienMon) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'DONG_MON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') GROUP BY TenMon ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT DAYNAME(BusinessDate) AS ThuTrongTuan, DAYOFWEEK(BusinessDate) AS ThuTu, SUM(TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y%m') GROUP BY DAYNAME(BusinessDate), DAYOFWEEK(BusinessDate) ORDER BY DAYOFWEEK(BusinessDate) LIMIT 500

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN BusinessDate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND BusinessDate < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END) AS DoanhThuThangNay, SUM(CASE WHEN BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) AND BusinessDate < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END) AS DoanhThuThangTruoc, SUM(CASE WHEN BusinessDate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND BusinessDate < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) AND BusinessDate < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END) AS ChenhLech, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN BusinessDate >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND BusinessDate < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) AND BusinessDate < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) AND BusinessDate < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') THEN TongTien ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2) AS PhanTramThayDoi FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) AND BusinessDate < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL '1' MONTH) LIMIT 500

SELECT TenNhaCungCap, SUM(DonGiaNhap * SoLuongNhap) AS TongGiaTriNhap FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'PHIEU_NHAP' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY TenNhaCungCap ORDER BY TongGiaTriNhap DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT t.MaNguyenLieu, t.TenNguyenLieu, t.SoLuongTon, t.MucTonToiThieu FROM vw_ai_quanly AS t WHERE t.LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND t.SoLuongTon < t.MucTonToiThieu AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vw_ai_quanly AS p WHERE p.LoaiBanGhi = 'PHIEU_NHAP' AND p.MaNguyenLieu = t.MaNguyenLieu AND p.BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY)) LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') AS Thang, AVG(TongTien) AS DoanhThuTrungBinhMoiOrder FROM (SELECT MaOrder, BusinessDate, SUM(TongTien) AS TongTien FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY MaOrder, BusinessDate) AS t GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(BusinessDate, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Thang LIMIT 500

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.ThoiDiemXuat, '%H:00') AS Gio, o.LoaiDon, SUM(h.TongTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_quanly AS h JOIN vw_ai_quanly AS o ON o.LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND o.MaOrder = h.MaOrder WHERE h.LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND h.BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '6' DAY) AND h.BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(h.ThoiDiemXuat, '%H:00'), o.LoaiDon ORDER BY Gio, o.LoaiDon LIMIT 500

SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon, SoLuongGiu FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND SoLuongGiu > 0 AND SoLuongTon < (SELECT AVG(SoLuongTon) FROM vw_ai_quanly WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO') ORDER BY SoLuongTon ASC LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDonBanDuocHomNay FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND TrangThaiOrder <> 'Đã hủy' LIMIT 500
SELECT SUM(SoTien) AS TongTienThu FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SoLuongGiaoDichQR FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND PhuongThuc = 'QR' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDonMangVe FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'ORDER' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND LoaiDon = 'Mang về' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SoGiaoDichTienMat FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE AND PhuongThuc = 'Tiền mặt' LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, CASE DAYOFWEEK(BusinessDate) WHEN 1 THEN 'Chủ nhật' WHEN 2 THEN 'Thứ hai' WHEN 3 THEN 'Thứ ba' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thứ tư' WHEN 5 THEN 'Thứ năm' WHEN 6 THEN 'Thứ sáu' WHEN 7 THEN 'Thứ bảy' END AS Thu, SUM(SoTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND YEARWEEK(BusinessDate, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURRENT_DATE, 1) GROUP BY BusinessDate, DAYOFWEEK(BusinessDate) ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500

SELECT HOUR(ThoiDiemXuat) AS Gio, COUNT(DISTINCT MaHoaDon) AS SoHoaDon FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'HOA_DON' AND BusinessDate = CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY HOUR(ThoiDiemXuat) ORDER BY Gio LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(SoTien) AS DoanhThu FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND YEAR(BusinessDate) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(BusinessDate) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY DoanhThu DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT PhuongThuc, COUNT(DISTINCT MaOrder) AS SoDon FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '30' DAY) GROUP BY PhuongThuc LIMIT 500

SELECT BusinessDate, SUM(SoTien) AS TongTienThu FROM vw_ai_thungan WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'THANH_TOAN' AND BusinessDate >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL '6' DAY) AND BusinessDate <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY BusinessDate ORDER BY BusinessDate LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MaNguyenLieu) AS SoNguyenLieu FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND SoLuongTon > 0 LIMIT 500
SELECT MaNguyenLieu, TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND SoLuongTon < 5 LIMIT 500
SELECT TenNguyenLieu, DonViTinh, SoLuongTon FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'TON_KHO' AND TenNguyenLieu = 'Thịt bò' LIMIT 500
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SoLuongGiaoDichKho FROM vw_ai_kho WHERE LoaiBanGhi = 'GIAO_DICH_KHO' LIMIT 500
